text: Coffee with Hugo and Olga. Olga's gone fully vegan since the summer, so no more cheese boards when they come over. Hugo's still on oat flat whites, three a day. Their housewarming is November 14. Olga said her sister Moira might come down from Aberdeen for it, and she's the one who's allergic to sesame, so I'll have to check the hummus situation with them nearer the time.
Dalia rang. Her mum's having her hip done on 2 November 2026 and Dalia's staying with her for a fortnight after. She sounded properly worn out. Need to check in with her that weekend.
Pick up gluten free pasta and the dry cleaning before Thursday.

Long catch-up with Aaliyah at lunch. She's coeliac, which I somehow never knew, and she was too polite to say anything at my barbecue. Her brother Tobi is starting at Leeds in September 2027. She wants a decent cafetiere, hint hint for her birthday on June 3rd.
Ximena and Anan are off to Lisbon 5/14 to 5/21. He's nervous about flying, she's mostly excited about the custard tarts.
Dev doesn't drink anymore, about a year now. Get some nice alcohol free beer in for Saturday.

Zeynep said Isaac got the job at the hospital, starts March 2027. She's thrilled but he's dreading the commute. Must send him a congrats text. Zeynep also said their youngest has started refusing anything green, so dinners at theirs are now mostly plain pasta and fish fingers, which Isaac secretly loves anyway.
Neha's peanut allergy is the serious kind, carries two EpiPens. Jamal mentioned it at the pub so I don't mess up the dinner menu.

Jamal and his wife are expecting! Due April 2027. He told me while we were queuing for coffee and looked terrified in the best way. Their dog Biscuit is apparently already jealous. His wife has bad morning sickness and can't stand the smell of coffee, so Jamal's switched to tea at home in solidarity. He asked if I knew any good antenatal classes near Headingley.
Rhys's stag was meant to be Prague on July 9th but it's off, his fiance's dad is unwell. Jakub said they might do a quiet curry night instead, nothing booked.
Car MOT due 12 December 2026. Book it this week, and the boiler service too.
Ethan hates coriander with a passion. Imani loves it. Note to self for when I cook for both.

Bumped into Beatriz at the market. Her daughter's graduating from Edinburgh on June 27th and Beatriz is flying over with her husband. She only drinks red, never white. Anil's going too apparently, he's her daughter's godfather. Should get a card for the graduate before then.
Did Joseph ever hear back about the biopsy? He had it done last Tuesday. Text him tomorrow.
Eilidh's moving to Glasgow end of January 2027, new flat in the West End. Bethany is gutted, they've lived together six years. I'm helping with the van on the 30th.
Ryan mentioned his grandad's 90th is on August 2. Big family lunch in Cork. Ryan wants to get him a really good bottle of whiskey, Redbreast probably.
Julien - lactose intolerant, loves espresso, hates tea. Lives in Bristol now. Works for an architecture firm, Moreau & Hughes, his uncle's place.
Moira's cat Pepper went missing on Sunday. She's put flyers everywhere. Ask her tomorrow if there's news.

Called Kalani. Her interview at the council is October 28th, second round. She's nervous because the panel is five people. Don't forget to wish her luck the night before. Her partner Alessia is making her practise answers over dinner every night this week, which is either sweet or slightly intense.
Ayesha's fasting for Ramadan from late February 2027 so no lunch plans then. Suggested we do iftar together one evening instead, she loved that.
Groceries: oat milk, almond flour, eggs, limes. Pharmacy for the prescription.

Anjali and Niamh got engaged over the weekend! Niamh proposed on the beach at Whitby. Wedding's probably summer 2028. They're both vegetarian so I'll look for a veggie place for the celebratory dinner.

Dmitri's knee surgery went fine on 9/12, now on crutches for six weeks. He's bored out of his mind. His sister Olga is bringing food round every other day. I should pop over with some board games. He mentioned he's been craving proper Georgian food, khachapuri especially, so maybe bring some from that bakery on the high street. Physio starts 10/3.
Hugo and Dev at five a side. Hugo's training for the Berlin marathon, September 26 2027, and has cut out booze completely. Dev reckons he'll last till Christmas.
Isaac's mum passed away on Friday. Funeral is November 6th. Zeynep is organising food for the wake. I need to send flowers and a card.
Tobi turns 21 on May 9. He's mad about Japanese whisky and ramen, and keeps saying he wants a proper chef's knife.
Note for the dinner party on the 15th: Neha no nuts, Ethan no coriander, Dev no alcohol, Aaliyah gluten free. Imani eats everything, bless her.
Renew passport before March 2027. Photos first.
Quick chat with Anil after work. He's struggling with the new manager, says she micromanages everything. Thinking about leaving by spring. Check in with him in a couple of weeks.
Beatriz's husband, Joseph, is doing the Great North Run on September 13th. First half marathon at 52. She's making him carb load on her famous lasagne the night before.
Eilidh brought her new puppy Haggis round. Utterly chaotic. She's also off dairy now, doctor's orders, something to do with her skin.
Ximena's back from Lisbon. Said Anan hated the flight but loved the trip. Ask her for the photos.

Lunch with Jakub and Rhys. Rhys is now pescatarian, which Jakub finds hilarious given he grew up on a farm. Jakub's daughter starts nursery on 1/6. Rhys has his driving test on the 22nd, third attempt, and he's genuinely anxious about it. Text him good luck that morning.
Ryan's partner Kalani cooks the best jollof I've ever had. Their anniversary is August 18, ten years. Ryan wants to surprise her with a weekend in Copenhagen.
Mrs Patel next door asked me to water her plants while she's in Gujarat, 3 December to 10 January.
Imani's sister Aaliyah is having a baby shower on April 4 2027. Imani is hosting. Apparently Aaliyah is craving pickles and nothing else.
Alessia only drinks Aperol spritz in summer and hot chocolate in winter, no exceptions. Funny thing to know about someone.
Must remember to ring Uncle Dmitri on his birthday, July 30th. Last year I forgot and Mum never let me hear the end of it.
Niamh Johnson, aka Nee, is the new team lead. She's a runner, a massive tea snob, and hates meetings before ten.
Dalia's mum is home from hospital, op went well. Dalia says she's eating again, mainly soup. Should drop round some of that lentil soup she likes.
Hugo's dad retires on 31 March 2027 after forty years at the same bank. Hugo's organising a surprise party, wants me to help with the playlist. His dad loves Motown and real ale.
Joseph keto again. Third time this year.
Anjali texted: her school play is on 12/10 and she's playing Mrs Bennet. She asked if I'd come. Her mum will be there too, the one who makes the incredible gulab jamun. Need to say yes.
Zeynep's son Ethan got into the youth orchestra! First concert is on June 19th. She's so proud. Don't forget to ask how the first rehearsal went.
Bin day moved to Wednesdays from November. Also council tax direct debit changes 1 December 2026.

Isaac and Neha are moving in together next month. He's a terrible cook, she's an amazing one, so it works. Neha's dad is a bit funny about it, apparently. Their flat viewing is Saturday 10th. Isaac asked if I could look over the tenancy agreement, since I went through the same nightmare last year. Neha wants a place with a gas hob, non negotiable apparently.
Moira Evans, my old lecturer, was at the conference. She's retiring after this year, moving to Skye. Still drinks her coffee black, no sugar. Asked me to send her my thesis chapter.

Talked to Bethany on the phone for ages. Her and Eilidh have officially split, and Eilidh's still moving to Glasgow, but it's for good now. Bethany's okay-ish, keeping busy. She's thinking of getting a dog. Her birthday is February 11, and she's mentioned wanting a pasta machine twice now.
Jamal's daughter Imani has her ballet exam on 3/22. He's more nervous than she is.
Book train to Manchester for May 14, return 5/16. Ask about the hotel deposit.
Ayesha is diabetic, type 1, so keep that in mind if we're out for dessert. She's fine talking about it but doesn't like fuss.

Dev's wedding was meant to be 20 June 2027 but they've pushed it to September 2027 because the venue double-booked. His fiancee Kalani is furious with the venue. I should check the new date works before booking flights.
Julien's little brother Anan is doing his GCSEs next summer. Julien says he's stressed and barely sleeping. Their mum asked Julien to help with French.
Rhys passed his driving test!!! Fourth time lucky. Celebrating with a pint at the Crown on Friday, me buying.

Saw Ximena and her dad at the farmers' market. He's recovering from a heart attack in August, now on a strict low salt diet and hating every minute. Ximena says he's sneaking crisps. She's off to Mexico City March 2027 for her cousin's wedding.
Olga said Dmitri's allergic to shellfish. Glad I asked before ordering the paella.
Clean out the garage this weekend and take the old sofa to the tip.

Anil's promotion came through, senior engineer from January 4. His wife Beatriz is planning a dinner to celebrate on the 15th, Thai place, he's mad for green curry. I'm bringing a bottle of something. Beatriz said their son Hugo might fly back from Toronto for it if he can get the time off, but it's not confirmed. Anil doesn't know yet, it's half a surprise.
Tobi said his flatmate Ryan has been struggling since his dad died in the spring. Not really eating. Tobi asked me to text Ryan sometime, just to say hi, no pressure.
Ethan O'Brien from accounts, Eth to everyone, is leaving on November 20 to go travelling. Leaving drinks at the Fox. Collecting for his gift: he wants a decent backpack.
